mapper.sql: SELECT w.id, 'RECEIPT' AS ledger_type, w.write_off_no AS ledger_no, r.project_id AS project_id, p.project_no AS project_no, w.receipt_id AS biz_id, rc.receipt_no AS biz_no, w.receivable_id AS receivable_id, r.receivable_no AS receivable_no, w.amount AS amount, w.status AS status, w.write_off_method AS method, w.write_off_date AS ledger_date, w.created_at AS created_at, w.operator_id AS created_by, NULL AS created_by_name, w.original_write_off_id AS original_ledger_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(w.ext, '$.reverseReason')) AS reverse_reason FROM fin_write_off w LEFT JOIN fin_receivable r ON r.id = w.receivable_id LEFT JOIN fin_project p ON p.id = r.project_id LEFT JOIN fin_receipt rc ON rc.id = w.receipt_id WHERE w.is_deleted = 0 AND (#{projectId} IS NULL OR r.project_id = #{projectId}) AND (#{ledgerType} IS NULL OR #{ledgerType} = '' OR 'RECEIPT' = #{ledgerType}) AND (#{status} IS NULL OR #{status} = '' OR w.status = #{status}) AND (#{keyword} IS NULL OR #{keyword} = '' OR w.write_off_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND (#{dateFrom} IS NULL OR w.write_off_date >= #{dateFrom}) AND (#{dateTo} IS NULL OR w.write_off_date <= #{dateTo}) UNION ALL SELECT a.id, 'INVOICE' AS ledger_type, a.allocation_no AS ledger_no, r.project_id AS project_id, p.project_no AS project_no, a.invoice_id AS biz_id, i.invoice_no AS biz_no, a.receivable_id AS receivable_id, r.receivable_no AS receivable_no, a.amount AS amount, a.status AS status, 'MANUAL' AS method, DATE(a.created_at) AS ledger_date, a.created_at AS created_at, NULL AS created_by, NULL AS created_by_name, a.original_allocation_id AS original_ledger_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.ext, '$.reverseReason')) AS reverse_reason FROM fin_invoice_allocation a LEFT JOIN fin_receivable r ON r.id = a.receivable_id LEFT JOIN fin_project p ON p.id = r.project_id LEFT JOIN fin_invoice i ON i.id = a.invoice_id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND (#{projectId} IS NULL OR r.project_id = #{projectId}) AND (#{ledgerType} IS NULL OR #{ledgerType} = '' OR 'INVOICE' = #{ledgerType}) AND (#{status} IS NULL OR #{status} = '' OR a.status = #{status}) AND (#{keyword} IS NULL OR #{keyword} = '' OR a.allocation_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND (#{dateFrom} IS NULL OR a.created_at >= #{dateFrom}) AND (#{dateTo} IS NULL OR a.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
